entities.summary: Autumn Peltier is an Anishinaabe Indigenous rights advocate from the Wikwemkong First Nation on Manitoulin Island. She was named Chief Water Commissioner for the Anishinabek Nation in 2019. In 2018, at the age of thirteen, Peltier addressed world leaders at the United Nations General Assembly on the issue of water protection.
